summary: feat(settings): add Nova semantic utilities and restyle shared components
description:
Because:
- Shared components set colors with raw utilities and hand-written dark: pairs.
- Acorn's semantic tokens express intent and own light/dark.
- FXA-14259 and FXA-14260 build on this setup.

This commit:
- Adds semantic utilities, a nova: variant and a light-dark() fallback to fxa-settings.
- Gives each semantic token today's light and dark value in legacy.css for flag-off.
- Swaps exact light/dark pairs for semantic utilities in 15 shared components.
- Restyles shared components under nova: per Figma; InputText error border is exclusive.
- Drops the Nova min-height from cta-base-p so anchor CTAs stay centered.
